mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) compress risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer and business confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through increased earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST show positive growth, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising labor force participation (PAYEMS growth) indicates sustained economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate hiring supports earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS is rising, or Rank IC for PAYEMS trend within regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0) signals strengthening manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits rise and supply chain pressures ease.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly year-over-year decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5.0% triggers market concerns about weakening consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real estate sector weakness signals broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST YoY < -5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Consistent growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates improving job market conditions, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate hiring support equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS shows positive growth, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), decelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY < 0%) signals successful policy without recession, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market anxiety subsides.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 0%, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
